verdict_text:
NO

The plan's bfloat16-cast regex omits `attention.dense.weight`, casting only `query_key_value`, `dense_h_to_4h`, and `dense_4h_to_h` (48 tensors, 3 of the 4 per-layer projection matrices) instead of all 64 required by clause 1. Its own required check compounds this: it asserts the matched-pattern count is 48, not that exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16 as required by "Required checks," so the missing `attention.dense.weight` cast goes undetected and those 16 tensors are left in float32 instead of bfloat16.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
